stem: An aquarium is being filled with water. The graph shows the height of the water over time as the aquarium is being filled.
instruction: Which statement best describes the rate of change for this situation?

options.label: A
options.text: The height of the water increases 20 inches per second.

options.label: B
options.text: The height of the water increases 1 inch per second.

options.label: C
options.text: The height of the water increases 5 inches per second.

options.label: D
options.text: The height of the water increases 2.5 inches per second.

visual_elements: Graph titled Aquarium with x-axis labeled Time (seconds) from 0 to 9 and y-axis labeled Height (inches) from 0 to 25, showing a straight line from (0,0) to (9,22.5)
